dispositions.F1: Accept fail-closed spend semantics. Any dispatch exception freezes that run and the remaining sequence. Preserve first partial evidence; never retry or clear markers. Any lease release requires a separate failure audit proving exact owned-process absence; never blindly restore ledger bytes.
dispositions.F2: Accept independently bounded observer. Parent never intentionally interrupts launcher. If launcher exits unexpectedly, do not relaunch; inspect original observer and registered watchdog read-only, preserve absent parent-exit receipt as a failure, and audit cleanup before exact lease release. Observer retains original 3780/3790s deadlines. Do not fabricate direct-reap evidence.
dispositions.F3: Parent preflight additionally requires progress-reports.jsonl, progress-alert.json, cancel and the shared state.pending path absent before dispatch. No stray-progress-file exposure accepted.
dispositions.F4: Close via approved-gates pin to exact registration-index-proposal.json plus its promoted registration-index.json. Existing gate_check calls check_pins on both; no launcher edit required.
dispositions.F5: Parent records verbatim future user message and concrete packet manifest plus exact run/SHA pairs. A single explicit approval may authorize this named five-run sequence; each run still gets a separate exact-once launch and audit. No hex strings need be typed by user.
dispositions.F6: Approval flags are schema attestations. Evidence is independent review, fixed registration/source/dependency pins and parent validations, not hard-coded passed labels alone.
dispositions.F7: Serialize parent launches; one active campaign and one dispatch process at a time. No concurrent ledger writers through audit.
dispositions.F8: Accept inherited launch body with 33 CPU gate/binding tests and actual first-control receipt; mutating remaining dispatcher is not claimed runtime-qualified before first use.
dispositions.F9: Monitor prints/returns; T3 background-command completion supplies the thread wake. This integration already produced actual completion notifications. Keep read-only single-monitor ownership; empty tmp directory carries no authority.

priority_runtime_scope: First priority run is first actual MPS execution for priority-sampled lists. Same frozen source/native/model path, different seed integers; fake sampler/stream checks only. Keep hard caps and attach independent read-only monitor.
